build_prior_transformer_model: build a PriorTransformer model with custom attention heads, layers, and embedding dimensions
run_prior_transformer_forward: run the PriorTransformer forward pass with hidden states, timestep, and projected embeddings
create_prior_transformer_output: create a PriorTransformerOutput dataclass wrapping the predicted image embedding tensor
set_default_attn_processor: set the default attention processor on a PriorTransformer model instance
post_process_latents: post process prior latents by applying learned clip mean and standard deviation scaling
